notes: PRINTED-APPENDIX SPECIFICATION (Nov 4, 2026): outside the main-text sample (PROTOCOL 5b ruling (r)); for the appendix-inclusive sensitivity analysis. Retail-to-Online Access design (gvar online_treat_time), CEM-matched sample of Appendix Table C.3 column (2) and Figures C.1-C.2 (Retail-to-Online panels). Matching: same matchit() call on rto_county_matching_info.csv, code.R lines 815-836; the estimation sample is rto_main_subset == T rows of the matched counties (code.R line 834), re-run with generate_results() and the usual weights; matching weights (all 1) are never used, so this is a 1:1 matched sample restriction (PROTOCOL 5b). sample_filter = rto_main_subset plus the 422 matched counties (211 eventually online, 211 retail-only; article: '211 (out of 1,077) ... and 211 (out of 498) control counties'), reproduced with MatchIt 4.7.2; the matched set reproduces all 12 printed matched-sample entries of Appendix Table C.2 to 4 decimals. Sample: 422 counties, quarters 9-30, 5,425 rows (unbalanced: 419 counties enter after quarter 9); 10 adoption cohorts (quarters 12,14,15,16,18,21,23,25,27,29); 211 never-online counties (47.5% of rows); no always-treated counties. Authors report Callaway-Sant'Anna with the main-text settings (code.R generate_results(), lines 277-364: did::att_gt, control_group = 'notyettreated', est_method = 'dr', base_period = 'varying', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, xformla = ~1, weightsname = 'num_individs_2015', clustervars = county, bstrap = TRUE without a seed; aggte(type = 'simple' or 'dynamic', min_e = -8, max_e = 16)). No TWFE regression exists in the package; the TWFE counterpart is D = 1[gvar > 0 & time >= gvar] with county FE + quarter FE, weights num_individs_2015, clustered by county. Treatment never switches off (defined from a unit-constant timing variable). Outcome levels were additively transformed by the authors to hide actual levels (README); county IDs anonymized; underlying UC Consumer Credit Panel is restricted. Project member Davide Proserpio is a coauthor (PROTOCOL Section 6). CAVEAT: the sample is an unbalanced panel with counties entering at their state's retail launch; did with allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE uses repeated-cross-section 2x2 cells whose control composition changes between g-1 and t, which drives the authors' and the pipeline's CSA estimates (see the replication log, 'composition-driven' section). TWFE and BJS are unaffected. y_sd_* are computed on the non-missing rows of the sample before drop_e_above, as in the main-text template.
